Bikeskills Trial courses give you the chance to work on your balance, overcoming obstacles and other skills that come in handy but there's no time to train during the season. Everyone can improve their position on the bike or try riding up a few pallets.

Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as winter preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Nupaky near Říčany). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The hall in Nupaky fits 2–3 riders at a time. The hall is heated with a blower heater.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.



LOCATION:

The course takes place at Nupacká 112, Nupaky 251 01, in a barn converted into a Trial hall. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. Parking is available nearby.

Mostly wooden obstacles on a concrete surface are available.

Hall location: Google Maps link




SUITABLE FOR:

Men, women and children. Children only when accompanied by parents, on an individual basis. Ideal for beginners, amateur and professional riders.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Courses and camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
